analysis: Reviewed the two head_text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 1218-2026). The diff is documentation-only: the date bump at line 3, an added Gemma 4 serial-prefill pipeline lane-width sentence near line 126, and further doc edits elsewhere in the file. The patch excerpt is truncated, so edits at about lines 4483-4538 and 4901-4927 are not visible to me. The excerpts I did see have no changed ranges; 1218-2026 falls between the changed ranges. They describe existing behavior: GLM5Next media and tool parsing, the calibration and shape warmup, deadline admission, MTP, and prefix-cache scoping. I checked that prose against the canonical threat model (T-041 cache scope, SEC-035, TB-002 encryption, TB-007 engine) for contradictions and found none. For example, the text says media requests are excluded from prefix lookup and capture, SSE frames are encrypted per frame, and ChunkBatcher drops frames when no sink is bound. All of this is consistent with T-008 and T-041. No code, no control changes and no new attack surface appear in the visible lines. Remaining question for integration: the new Gemma pipeline default-width claim (lines 126-129, 3048, 3100) concerns cluster lane widening and is not visible in my units. Whether the real code behavior matches it, and whether it affects availability or memory-reservation threats, would need review of the corresponding source.
